programme.desc: S02 E09 — The House That Chose Us Listen as Kaitlin describes her ardent wish to see her departed mother just one more time. Join Brandon and Mustafa as they try to help her make contact, then see if a person's belief in the supernatural can be a conduit for paranormal experiences.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries: Family Spirits

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Haunted by a Rock Legend and More Paranormal investigators get a chilling response from a dearly departed rock legend; a ghostly canine joins its former owner for a nighttime stroll; a man and his co-workers spot a gaggle of UFOs in the Louisiana bayou.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Deadly Crossbow (The Ryan Family Story) Brett Ryan paves a long road of deception. The serial-lying ex-con hides his bank-robbing past from his fiancé and misleads his family, before a late-night confession to his mother leads to a murder no one could have seen coming.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Miami Sinking The coastal metropolis of Miami faces a triple threat of crumbling limestone bedrock, ferocious superstorms and relentless rising oceans.
programme.title: Brink of Disaster

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Triangular Craft Probe a case that inspired an eyewitness to write a book about UFO sightings.
programme.title: UFO Chronicles

programme.desc: The Pascagoula Incident Meet Calvin Parker and Charles Hickson, who claimed they were abducted and examined by aliens aboard a UFO in 1973. Listen in as experts try to find the true story among the pair's polygraph.
programme.title: UFO Chronicles

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Murdered Pharaoh & Ghostly Wine The fate of Pharaoh Ramses III has long been clouded by rumors of a family plot against him; scientists examine the tomb, uncovering evidence that supports these ancient suspicions.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S03 E03 — When Ghosts Speak An evil spirit tells Dawn Whitehair to get out of her new home; a jealous ghost plagues Chris Page, wanting him all to herself; an entity tormenting a family possesses the medium they brought in to help to convey a chilling message.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S01 E08 A mysterious doorway on Mars; victims of a UFO in the Amazon; an alien party crasher at the Queen's Jubilee in London; animal mutilations in France; a video of otherworldly visitors to Turkey.
programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained

programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S03 E03 — Paul Chuckle Summoning the decidedly unfunny bogeyman that is chasing one half of the comedy duo "The Chuckle Brothers"; Investigating strange handprints and a pint-sized presence that might also be signs that Paul's late brother, Barry, is watching over him.
programme.title: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted
